In the first world the first time that class happens... The class was about the 6th wall breaking!

Which led him to making his own story where his char AC realises that he is just a character whithin someone's story. Further into the story AC realises that he is probably the main char!!

In the second world A remembers or imagines the entire story and finally wakes up in the class. Confused whether it was just his imagination or a dream or maybe his actual another life that he had probably lived a long ago!
